Usage: lwe <command> [value]

Everyday
  status                            what is on screen, the timer and the version
  show <wallpaper>                  one wallpaper on every screen now
  next, prev                        step forward or back
  pause [on|off|toggle]             hold or resume the playlist timer
  off, on                           take the wallpaper off the screens, or put it back
  playlist [<playlist>]             list your playlists, or switch to one
  schedule ...                      day and night playlists; help schedule shows how

Settings  (a name alone shows how to use it)
  volume <0-128|+N|-N>              wallpaper sound
  mute <on|off|toggle>              silence every wallpaper
  mouse <on|off|toggle>             off stops every wallpaper following the pointer
  parallax <on|off|toggle>          off stops the depth shift everywhere
  audioreactive <on|off|toggle>     off stops every wallpaper reacting to sound
  speed <0.1-10|0>                  animation speed; 0 freezes, not saved; speed load brings it back
  order <shuffle|sequential|static> how the playlist moves on
  interval <20m|30s|1h>             how long each wallpaper stays up
  fps <1-480>                       frames per second
  resclamp <0-4>                    cap on scene size, in screens; 0 is no cap
  effectclamp <0-4>                 the same cap for glow and blur layers
  <setting> load                    put one value back to what your files say
  get <setting>...                  bare values for scripts and bars

Library
  list [scene|video|web]            your library, numbered
  workshop                          downloads not in your library yet, numbered
  scan                              look for new downloads now
  add <wallpaper>...                into the pool; --playlist <playlist> also puts it in that
                                    playlist
  remove <wallpaper>... --playlist <playlist>
                                    take it out of that playlist
  trash <wallpaper>...              out of the pool; untrash lets it back in
  compress <wallpaper>...           build the fast textures
  bench <wallpaper>                 a test window, then its log summary
  wallpaper <wallpaper> ...         one wallpaper's own settings, alias, properties, objects

Setup
  config [<setting> [value]]        every setting, its value and where it came from
  reload                            check every file, print what changed, apply
  backup export|import|preview <file>
                                    save, restore or preview a backup
  service [start|stop|restart]      the wallpaper service; service autostart on|off
  debug <switch> <value>            unsupported debugging switches; help --debug lists them

Pick a wallpaper by its number in a list, its Workshop id, @alias, its title in quotes,
or current for the one on screen.
help <command> explains one. help files lists the files you edit. help --all lists every setting.
